context.description: A subtree run whose outside folder task is trusted runs, and /task trust cannot trust a folder task

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of verify-spec-VF7.spec.ts (4 tests, 33 expects). My own runs: 4 pass, 0 fail, exit 0 at 6d3f86d553, and again at 2e6ff969e3, which holds the trust-drop fix 109948a797; the test file and helpers are unchanged since af2bdf043e. Given: a whole-spec slice stored on the run aggregate whose fold has T1.1 trusted. When: the real TaskCommand.run on the T1.3 folder, the real job run on its own fiber (Recorder, run machine, run supervisor). Then the run starts: the run header, one job, and the lease path T1.3. The new slice's first two facts are run.started with the T1.3 path, then outside.trusted T1.1. The fold through the T1.3 plan gives T1.1 untrusted after the first fact and trusted after the second. The old slice is unchanged. And /task trust T1.1 never moves an external region: (a) in a command-started live run, trust T9, T1.1, T8 through the real command; the directory aggregate holds all three, and the run slice holds T1.1 only once (from start-up), then T9 and T8. (b) A real run supervisor whose external region T1.1 is untrusted: T9 and T8 move, T1.1 stays untrusted in the snapshot and in the fold, no fact names T1.1, and T1.3 is not ready. T9 before and T8 after prove that the run handled the T1.1 trust and did not drop it. (c) With no trusted slice, a typed trust T1.1 does not stop the R12 refusal. Defect link: the tests wait for the supervisor in running with a snapshot before they send a trust, so they do not depend on the start-up trust drop and do not test its fix. The fix's pending path keeps the untrustedOutside filter, so an external id stays excluded.
